audience_summary: Privacy-first households and self-hosters who want an offline-capable personal cloud, inline network protection, and local AI in one low-power appliance—plus early supporters ready to back a Kickstarter.
stack_note: Monorepo `heyeddi-doomsday-box`: `website/` = Phase 0 market-intent Vue SPA (heyeddi.com hero; Postmark DOI; Stripe custom amount $0 lead / ≥$1 paid intent up to ∞; no prototype video required); `box/` = on-device software (Debian/Ubuntu, Docker Compose, FastAPI + Vue/PrimeVue, nftables, Ollama; N100/N150 + ARM64). Kickstarter later when prototype+video exist.

personas.name: Alex
personas.primary_job: Run personal cloud and local AI on hardware they control without cloud lock-in
personas.anxiety: Vendor telemetry, brittle DIY stacks, and software that never ships open
personas.design_implication: Concrete capability list; honest OSS timeline; clear DIY vs hardware paths

personas.name: Morgan
personas.primary_job: Protect home network and keep family data usable offline
personas.anxiety: Outages, ads/trackers, and gadgets that need constant cloud
personas.design_implication: Plain-language outcomes first; low jargon; trust via transparency

personas.name: Casey
personas.primary_job: Show demand with email at $0 or paid intent at $1+ before Kickstarter
personas.anxiety: Paying without clarity, or being asked for a demo that does not exist yet
personas.design_implication: Amount field allows 0 and custom ≥1; honest no-video / not-a-pledge copy; measure paid intent

route_intent.mindset: Curious; may pay $1+ to signal demand without a prototype video
route_intent.success_feeling: I joined at $0 or showed paid intent in under a minute without being sold a fake demo

pages.purpose: Single-page Vue: hero, pitch, planned perks (reference only), email + amount ($0 or ≥$1→∞), disclosure; no prototype video; CTA from heyeddi.com hero

competitive_edge: One appliance combining sovereign personal cloud, inline firewall/ad-tarpit, and offline local AI—open-source after campaign fulfillment, with a high-trust Kickstarter path
anti_audience: Enterprise SSO buyers, people seeking cloud-only SaaS, and anyone wanting equity crowdfunding or charity fundraising on Kickstarter
voice_tone: Direct, sovereignty-forward, no hype. Verb-first CTAs. Honest about crowdfunding rules and planned perks. Calm confidence over prepper panic.
brand_personality: HeyEddi product line: practical digital sovereignty appliance with campaign energy on Doomsday Box naming
design_references: Umbrel: clear personal-server value without enterprise chrome
Kickstarter hardware campaigns: perk clarity and early-bird urgency without scammy scarcity
anti_references: Generic purple SaaS landing with floating badge clusters
Fear-mongering prepper marketing with cluttered stat strips
Multi-page marketing site when a single scroll page suffices
